title: Thai-Style Crispy Morbier Spring Rolls
description: A unique twist on traditional spring rolls, featuring the creamy texture of Morbier cheese and the crunch of crispy vegetables.
instructions: 1. In a large pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the crispy vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the Morbier cheese and cook until melted and creamy, about 2-3 minutes.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the soy sauce and rice vinegar.
5. Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the vegetable and cheese mixture in the center.
6. Brush the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the bottom half up over the filling.
7. Fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
8. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
9. Serve the spring rolls hot with the soy sauce and rice vinegar mixture for dipping.
